name: The Debater
work_style: Idea generation, challenge-seeking, and opportunistic. Thrive in the early, ambiguous phase of any project. Excel at seeing possibilities others miss. Get bored with routine and need constant novelty.
energy_drains: Being told 'that's how we've always done it'
environment_needs: Permission to challenge the status quo
decision_making: Quick to form opinions but genuinely open to counter-arguments. Enjoy debate as a means of reaching better decisions. Can be perceived as contrarian — actually just stress-testing ideas.
leadership_style: Lead through energy and ideas. Excel at rallying people around bold new directions. Need strong operational partners to execute.
